title: Moya o o Disitseng fa Lebopong la Noka
intro: Moya o monnye o ne o newa thomo ya sephiri, go ela tlhoko o le kgakala ka tsela e e babalesegileng fa phelelo e ntse e diragala mo metsing. Fa palo eno e ne e sa bonwe e bile e sa belaelwe, e ne e tla nna le seabe se se botlhokwa thata mo go fetoleng tsela ya hisitori ya setšhaba.
clues: Ke ne ka newa tiro ke mmè, e e neng e tlhoka gore ke iphitlhele ke bo ke nne kelotlhoko.
Matlho a me a ne a latela setshodi se sennye se se neng se kgweetsa mo moela, pelo ya me e imetswe ke go tshwenyega.
Fa e bonwa ke lekoko le le sa lebelelwang, ke ne ka atamela, ke tletse ka letshogo.
Ke ne ka bona go itlhoboga ga bone ga go batla motlhokomedi mme ka ba naya tharabololo kwantle ga go senola boammaaruri.
Go tsereganya ga me ka nako go ne ga busetsa moya o o amusang kwa go yo o neng a o tlhoka thata.
Mo dikgotleng tsa batho ba ba nang le maatla, ke ne ka bua jaana: ‘A ke go kaele kwa lelapeng le le tla mo fepang le go mo tlhokomela ka kelotlhoko?’

arabic: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَـٰصِحُونَ
verse: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?" (28:12)
